name: Ladispoli (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ladispoli (wheat ears on yellow and a tower on blue) within branches, with the motto TYRRHENI AD LITORA REGIS on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of Ladispoli, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 24 December 1996.

features.role: Ladispoli arms — wheat ears on yellow and a tower on blue, crowned, within branches, with motto TYRRHENI AD LITORA REGIS
